cases.head: d4ce612a1b877e55836d0ccee4aaea745a294f07
cases.rationale: The change orders multiple predicate columns using selectivity from the first batch. The saved experiment has one predicate and does not observe column decode order.

cases.head: 77ccc73709d0fb850e9fa70e76e3b14d93a0ba69
cases.rationale: Pushdown-on and pushdown-off row parity under schema conversion is a relevant control. The fixture does not exercise timestamp-unit conversion.

cases.head: f3c0d5f10b83d9248609d4b68e87359dcde325b3
cases.rationale: The fix handles a streaming range predicate and specialized IsBetween decoding. The stored workload uses a single equality predicate.

cases.head: f949d73789cd2664969d875bcd4ab448865dd7df
cases.rationale: The change limits decoder allocation to selected values. Counting rows pruned would not distinguish the decoder allocations or the empty-chunk regression.

cases.head: 92086ac13803a139f2a9d4f36c9ed21a35d882e1
cases.rationale: An undefined storage event requires rereading persistent storage. Vanilla store replacement does not exercise browser storage events or rereads.

cases.head: 107a7e995212ec88839f2cfda12f0458d615c5c2
cases.rationale: The fix concerns watcher teardown when a Vue effect scope ends and listener behavior before mount. Plain unsubscribe does not exercise Vue lifecycle rules.

cases.head: 2768b7e5d3e028fa81184d20bcf0caa6c249f400
cases.rationale: A null update and notification are relevant behaviors. The saved fixture cannot verify DOM storage events or restoration of defaults in a second instance.

cases.head: d9b5a42302a70bd05887d7b637c60a18c1be58f9
cases.rationale: Switching a reactive storage key reroutes persisted reads and writes. Neither query key hashing nor vanilla store replacement exercises reactive key changes in browser storage.

cases.head: 687aa54e1a65788d965f24947f07b61d3b02c9a1
cases.rationale: Comparing correct rows with actual scan work under both pushdown settings is a useful control. It cannot verify Spark-to-Comet configuration forwarding.

cases.head: d04897e48357e511d4d85c6f38e03dec5b5cf51c
cases.rationale: The fix preserves type-conversion errors when runtime join filtering would skip rows. The saved predicate check exercises valid casts without a join or expected errors.

cases.head: 0d206f31d9069fa4d740b7da0c2dd164b7ee7e73
cases.rationale: This adds runtime hash-join domain filtering and row-group skipping. Static struct predicate row pruning does not exercise a build-side domain or join execution.

cases.head: 4f2951f1277b75e5515ce07d35c8b0be1b4a3e1f
cases.rationale: Partial MIN/MAX updates a live bound across row groups. The fixture has neither an aggregate bound nor multiple row groups to skip.

cases.head: e528bb9b997eb89d794ed95c38f4d502da01ddb7
cases.rationale: The enabled/disabled scan comparison is a relevant check for the intended behavior. The existing fixture alone cannot verify that Spark configuration reaches the engine.

cases.head: 2ddfd715c8313967db82ef2c957b69b7ff143bb8
cases.rationale: Ordinary notification and unsubscribe are related controls. The fixture does not unsubscribe during dispatch or assert that the next listener still fires.

cases.head: 5065cab676f58846a8597cb3a38781b700c6fac0
cases.rationale: The change rejects store operations inside an executing reducer. The vanilla test calls methods outside dispatch and has no reducer reentrancy.

cases.head: 69f8d977625b35d22d72ec6df54c3aab7f59a62a
cases.rationale: The modified contract rejects a non-function listener. The saved experiment subscribes a valid callback and does not cover argument validation.

cases.head: 9ab0a700121d8f4ea0316ef555e452b2a0d207d1
cases.rationale: This fixes the PreloadedState type calculation for unknown fields. The runtime experiment does not compile a consumer of the public types.

cases.head: fba87fea2923904837eefe4f134852a9b9bc951e
cases.rationale: The fix restricts which preloaded state properties TypeScript treats as partial. Checking a runtime shallow merge would not verify this type-level distinction.

cases.head: 1599aadb204a09e7b43dbb04b66582f056b3c83d
cases.rationale: The new listener Map must preserve ordinary notifications and unsubscribe. The saved control does not register the same callback twice or measure removal cost.

cases.head: 6c37b79fb48a266034f560e659f467749d9b07b8
cases.rationale: Basic unsubscribe is a useful control. The regression requires disposing twice with a second active listener, which the saved single-listener case cannot reproduce.

cases.head: ff5267c4f1e11c8b30d29823f2e75d04a792b5f1
cases.rationale: A function key must pass its evaluated arguments to the subscription callback. The saved key tests check cache identity and have no function-key subscription callback.

cases.head: e3ea9ca4e040ccf6e215cc47d2f5616d9ca306a5
cases.rationale: An infinite-list key change must restore its cached page size. The key-equivalence fixture has no pagination or page-size restoration.

cases.head: b58d4a06657c68d7527e9b5623d3b0d94182af8b
cases.rationale: The change adjusts the TypeScript cache-provider interface. The saved cache fixture exercises runtime behavior.

cases.head: 1e32f6b403504e20e57a042fd7fd0ccde64d5415
cases.rationale: The change gates loading-state writes on whether a new request starts. The saved query fixture does not assert SWR loading state across deduplicated requests.

cases.head: b6060f40bd18863c0b38f97c94f1fd62e3faf3a0
cases.rationale: Stable hashing sorts object keys and treats array order separately. The saved reordered-object and distinct-array checks directly exercise those semantics.
